execution.description: Ran the full affected Cooling, Graphite Phase 3/4, pod and miner-path slice from a native-Linux disposable checkout, then stopped at 59 percent to isolate the repeated failures fail-fast.

expected: The complete affected slice should pass in the pinned Linux environment.
observed: Pytest reached 59 percent with multiple failures before the diagnostic stop. The subsequent fail-fast run identified the shared environmental root: the disposable clone's Git object alternates path was outside the canonical container, so in-memory real-pod checks could not read the pinned commit.
keep: Keep the native-Linux disposable checkout approach; bootstrap, dependency lock and pytest execution all worked.
change: Make the disposable clone's Git object store self-contained, then rerun the same canonical slice.
